related_questions.question: How to check the Aadhaar PAN link status?
related_questions.snippet: Step 1: On the e-Filing Portal homepage, under Quick Links, click Link Aadhaar Status. Step 2: Enter your PAN and Aadhaar Number, and click View Link Aadhaar Status. On successful validation, a message will be displayed regarding your Link Aadhaar Status.
related_questions.title: Link Aadhaar User Manual | Income Tax Department

related_questions.question: How can I pay my income tax online in India?
related_questions.snippet: Step 1: Go to the e-Filing portal www.incometax.gov.in and click e-Pay Tax. Step 2: On the e-Pay Tax page, fill the required details and click Continue. Step 3: On the OTP Verification page, enter the 6-digit OTP received on the mobile number entered in Step 2 and click Continue.
related_questions.title: Tax payment through Payment Gateway User Manual - Income Tax

related_questions.question: How can I check my ITR return status?
related_questions.snippet: Step 1: Go to the e-Filing portal homepage. Step 2: Click Income Tax Return (ITR) Status. Step 3: On the Income Tax Return (ITR) Status page, enter your acknowledgement number and a valid mobile number and click Continue.
related_questions.title: Know your ITR Status User Manual - Income Tax Department

related_questions.question: How can I verify my PAN card online?
related_questions.snippet: Step 1: Go to e-Filing portal homepage. Step 2: Click Verify Your PAN on the e-Filing homepage. Step 3: On the Verify Your PAN page, enter your PAN, Full Name, Date of Birth and Mobile Number (accessible to you) and click Continue.
related_questions.title: Verify Your PAN User Manual | Income Tax Department
